root.label: Beit Hanina home demolition and Jabal al-Mukaber forced demolition

events.label: Beit Hanina home demolition and Jabal al-Mukaber forced demolition

slots.name: homes demolished
slots.sentence: On Monday morning another home was demolished in the East Jerusalem neighbourhood of Beit Hanina, according to Wafa, and authorities forced a Palestinian man in the city’s Jabal al-Mukaber area to demolish his home.
